note: 50 conversational prompts. Gazelle is the lean conversational path, so the set is deliberately what people actually say to a chat agent — not coding tasks, which would rig the comparison toward the tool-using coder path. Mix is roughly: factual recall, explanation, judgement/advice, short creative, and ambiguous asks where offering to escalate is the RIGHT answer.

categories.explain: conceptual explanation — correctness is whether it misleads
categories.ambiguous: needs tools or context to answer well; offering to switch is correct
